summary:
Main
Prices recovered together today, easing the previous session's broad weakness. DCE most-traded rose 0.90% to 675.0 yuan/mt;the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices increased to 658, 616 and 817 yuan/wmt. The seaborne 61% and 65% indices were USD 89.20 and 106.80/dmt, with all 12 brands higher.
